title: पञ्चचत्वारिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 145 · The Brahmin's lament at Ekachakra

summary.en: The Pandavas live by begging at Ekachakra. One day Kunti hears loud weeping in their host's house, and the Brahmin laments that he must lose a member of his family or himself, and cannot bear either.
summary.kn: ಏಕಚಕ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಂಡವರು ಭಿಕ್ಷೆಯಿಂದ ಜೀವಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಒಂದು ದಿನ ಆತಿಥೇಯನ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾದ ಅಳು ಕುಂತಿಗೆ ಕೇಳುತ್ತದೆ; ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಒಬ್ಬನನ್ನಾಗಲಿ ತನ್ನನ್ನಾಗಲಿ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕಾಗಿದೆ, ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಸಹಿಸಲಾರೆ ಎಂದು ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣನು ವಿಲಪಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: एकचक्रा में पाण्डव भिक्षा से जीवन बिताते हैं। एक दिन कुन्ती अपने आश्रयदाता के घर में ज़ोर का रोना सुनती हैं; ब्राह्मण विलाप करता है कि उसे परिवार के किसी सदस्य को या स्वयं को खोना होगा, और वह दोनों में से कुछ नहीं सह सकता।
summary.te: ఏకచక్రపురంలో పాండవులు భిక్షతో జీవిస్తారు. ఒకరోజు ఆతిథ్యమిచ్చిన ఇంట్లో గట్టిగా ఏడుపు కుంతికి వినిపిస్తుంది; కుటుంబంలో ఒకరినో తననో కోల్పోవలసి వస్తోంది, ఏదీ సహించలేనని బ్రాహ్మణుడు విలపిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: ஏகசக்ரத்தில் பாண்டவர்கள் பிச்சை எடுத்து வாழ்கிறார்கள். ஒருநாள் தங்கியிருந்த வீட்டில் பெரும் அழுகையைக் குந்தி கேட்கிறாள்; குடும்பத்தில் ஒருவரையோ தன்னையோ இழக்க வேண்டியிருக்கிறது, எதையும் தாங்க முடியாது என்று அந்தணர் புலம்புகிறார்.
summary.ml: ഏകചക്രത്തിൽ പാണ്ഡവർ ഭിക്ഷ യാചിച്ച് ജീവിക്കുന്നു. ഒരു ദിവസം ആതിഥേയന്റെ ഗൃഹത്തിൽ ഉച്ചത്തിലുള്ള കരച്ചിൽ കേട്ട് കുന്തി അന്വേഷിക്കുന്നു; കുടുംബത്തിലെ ഒരംഗത്തെയോ സ്വയമോ നഷ്ടപ്പെടേണ്ടിവരുമെന്നും, രണ്ടും സഹിക്കാനാവില്ലെന്നും ബ്രാഹ്മണൻ വിലപിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.145; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: जनमेजय उवाच

meaning.en: Janamejaya said:

verses.text:
एकचक्रां गतास्ते तु कुन्तीपुत्रा महारथाः ।
अतः परं द्विजश्रेष्ठ किमकुर्वत पाण्डवाः ॥

meaning.en: 'The sons of Kunti, great chariot-warriors, had gone to Ekachakra. What did the Pandavas do after that, best of Brahmins?'

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एकचक्रां गतास्ते तु कुन्तीपुत्रा महारथाः ।
ऊषुर्नातिचिरं कालं ब्राह्मणस्य निवेशने ॥

meaning.en: The great chariot-warriors, sons of Kunti, having gone to Ekachakra, stayed not very long in a Brahmin's house.

verses.text:
रमणीयानि पश्यन्तो वनानि विविधानि च ।
पार्थिवानपि चोद्देशान्सरितश्च सरांसि च ॥

meaning.en: They looked at lovely and varied forests, at royal places, rivers and lakes.

verses.text:
चेरुर्भैक्षं तदा ते तु सर्व एव विशां पते ।
बभूवुर्नागराणां च स्वैर्गुणैः प्रियदर्शनाः ॥

meaning.en: All of them went begging then, lord of the people, and became dear to the townspeople's eyes by their own virtues.

verses.text:
निवेदयन्ति स्म च ते भैक्षं कुन्त्याः सदा निशि ।
तया विभक्तान्भागांस्ते भुञ्जते स्म पृथक्पृथक् ॥

meaning.en: At night they always gave the alms to Kunti, and she divided it, and they ate their separate shares.

verses.text:
अर्धं ते भुञ्जते वीराः सह मात्रा परंतपाः ।
अर्धं भैक्षस्य सर्वस्य भीमो भुङ्क्ते महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: The heroes, scorchers of foes, ate half with their mother, and mighty Bhima ate the other half of all the alms.

verses.text:
तथा तु तेषां वसतां तत्र राजन्महात्मनाम् ।
अतिचक्राम सुमहान्कालोऽथ भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: While those great souls lived there, O king, a very long time passed, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
ततः कदाचिद्भैक्षाय गतास्ते भरतर्षभाः ।
संगत्या भीमसेनस्तु तत्रास्ते पृथया सह ॥

meaning.en: Then one day, when the others had gone to beg, Bhimasena stayed behind with Pritha.

verses.text:
अथार्तिजं महाशब्दं ब्राह्मणस्य निवेशने ।
भृशमुत्पतितं घोरं कुन्ती शुश्राव भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then Kunti heard a great, terrible cry of anguish arise from the Brahmin's house, O Bharata.

verses.text:
रोरूयमाणांस्तान्सर्वान्परिदेवयतश्च सा ।
कारुण्यात्साधुभावाच्च देवी राजन्न चक्षमे ॥

meaning.en: Hearing them all crying and lamenting, the lady could not bear it, from compassion and goodness, O king.

verses.text:
मथ्यमानेव दुःखेन हृदयेन पृथा ततः ।
उवाच भीमं कल्याणी कृपान्वितमिदं वचः ॥

meaning.en: Her heart as if churned by sorrow, the gracious Pritha then spoke these pitying words to Bhima.

verses.text:
वसामः सुसुखं पुत्र ब्राह्मणस्य निवेशने ।
अज्ञाता धार्तराष्ट्राणां सत्कृता वीतमन्यवः ॥

meaning.en: 'We live very comfortably in this Brahmin's house, son, unknown to Dhritarashtra's sons, well treated and free of anger.

verses.text:
सा चिन्तये सदा पुत्र ब्राह्मणस्यास्य किं न्वहम् ।
प्रियं कुर्यामिति गृहे यत्कुर्युरुषिताः सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: 'I keep thinking, son, what I could do to please this Brahmin, for what lodgers do for the household that gives them comfort.

verses.text:
एतावान्पुरुषस्तात कृतं यस्मिन्न नश्यति ।
यावच्च कुर्यादन्योऽस्य कुर्यादभ्यधिकं ततः ॥

meaning.en: 'This is what a man is, dear son: that the good done to him is not lost, and he does even more than another has done for him.

verses.text:
तदिदं ब्राह्मणस्यास्य दुःखमापतितं ध्रुवम् ।
तत्रास्य यदि साहाय्यं कुर्याम सुकृतं भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: 'Surely sorrow has fallen on this Brahmin. If we could help him in it, it would be a good deed.'

verses.text: भीम उवाच

meaning.en: Bhima said:

verses.text:
ज्ञायतामस्य यद्दुःखं यतश्चैव समुत्थितम् ।
विदिते व्यवसिष्यामि यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुष्करम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Let us find out what his grief is and where it comes from. Once I know, I will set to work, even if it is very hard.'

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
तथा हि कथयन्तौ तौ भूयः शुश्रुवतुः स्वनम् ।
आर्तिजं तस्य विप्रस्य सभार्यस्य विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: As the two were speaking, they heard again the cry of anguish of that Brahmin and his wife, lord of the people.

verses.text:
अन्तःपुरं ततस्तस्य ब्राह्मणस्य महात्मनः ।
विवेश कुन्ती त्वरिता बद्धवत्सेव सौरभी ॥

meaning.en: Then Kunti went quickly into the inner rooms of that great Brahmin, like the cow Surabhi to her tethered calf.

verses.text:
ततस्तं ब्राह्मणं तत्र भार्यया च सुतेन च ।
दुहित्रा चैव सहितं ददर्श विकृताननम् ॥

meaning.en: There she saw the Brahmin with his wife, his son and his daughter, his face distorted.

verses.text: ब्राह्मण उवाच

meaning.en: The Brahmin said:

verses.text:
धिगिदं जीवितं लोकेऽनलसारमनर्थकम् ।
दुःखमूलं पराधीनं भृशमप्रियभागि च ॥

meaning.en: 'Shame on this life in the world, as empty as flame, useless, rooted in sorrow, dependent on others, and mostly unpleasant.

verses.text:
जीविते परमं दुःखं जीविते परमो ज्वरः ।
जीविते वर्तमानस्य द्वन्द्वानामागमो ध्रुवः ॥

meaning.en: 'In life is the greatest sorrow, in life the greatest fever; for one who lives, pairs of opposites surely come.

verses.text:
एकात्मापि हि धर्मार्थौ कामं च न निषेवते ।
एतैश्च विप्रयोगोऽपि दुःखं परमकं मतम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Even a single self cannot fully enjoy dharma, wealth and desire; and separation from them is also counted the greatest pain.

verses.text:
आहुः केचित्परं मोक्षं स च नास्ति कथंचन ।
अर्थप्राप्तौ च नरकः कृत्स्न एवोपपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: 'Some say liberation is the highest, but it is nowhere to be had; and in getting wealth the whole of hell is found.

verses.text:
अर्थेप्सुता परं दुःखमर्थप्राप्तौ ततोऽधिकम् ।
जातस्नेहस्य चार्थेषु विप्रयोगे महत्तरम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Longing for wealth is great sorrow, and getting it is more; and when one has grown fond of possessions, losing them is greatest.

verses.text:
न हि योगं प्रपश्यामि येन मुच्येयमापदः ।
पुत्रदारेण वा सार्धं प्राद्रवेयामनामयम् ॥

meaning.en: 'I see no way by which I could be freed from this danger, or flee safe with my wife and son.

verses.text:
यतितं वै मया पूर्वं यथा त्वं वेत्थ ब्राह्मणि ।
यतः क्षेमं ततो गन्तुं त्वया तु मम न श्रुतम् ॥

meaning.en: 'I tried before, as you know, Brahmin lady, to go where there was safety, but you did not listen to me.

verses.text:
इह जाता विवृद्धास्मि पिता चेह ममेति च ।
उक्तवत्यसि दुर्मेधे याच्यमाना मयासकृत् ॥

meaning.en: 'You said, foolish woman, when I begged you again and again: I was born and grew up here, and this was my father's place.

verses.text:
स्वर्गतो हि पिता वृद्धस्तथा माता चिरं तव ।
बान्धवा भूतपूर्वाश्च तत्र वासे तु का रतिः ॥

meaning.en: 'Your old father and mother have long since gone to heaven, and your relatives of the past too; what pleasure is there in staying here?

verses.text:
सोऽयं ते बन्धुकामाया अशृण्वन्त्या वचो मम ।
बन्धुप्रणाशः संप्राप्तो भृशं दुःखकरो मम ॥

meaning.en: 'Wanting your kin, you did not listen to my words, and now the destruction of my kin has come, causing me great pain.

verses.text:
अथ वा मद्विनाशोऽयं न हि शक्ष्यामि कंचन ।
परित्यक्तुमहं बन्धुं स्वयं जीवन्नृशंसवत् ॥

meaning.en: 'Or rather it is my own destruction. I could not, being myself alive, abandon any relative like a cruel man.

verses.text:
सहधर्मचरीं दान्तां नित्यं मातृसमां मम ।
सखायं विहितां देवैर्नित्यं परमिकां गतिम् ॥

meaning.en: 'You are my partner in dharma, self-controlled, always like a mother to me, a friend given by the gods, my constant highest refuge.

verses.text:
मात्रा पित्रा च विहितां सदा गार्हस्थ्यभागिनीम् ।
वरयित्वा यथान्यायं मन्त्रवत्परिणीय च ॥

meaning.en: 'You were given to me by your mother and father to share the householder's life, and I chose you by the rule and married you with mantras.

verses.text:
कुलीनां शीलसंपन्नामपत्यजननीं मम ।
त्वामहं जीवितस्यार्थे साध्वीमनपकारिणीम् ।
परित्यक्तुं न शक्ष्यामि भार्यां नित्यमनुव्रताम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Of good family and good character, mother of my child, virtuous, never harming me, always devoted: I cannot abandon you, my wife, to save my own life.

verses.text:
कुत एव परित्यक्तुं सुतां शक्ष्याम्यहं स्वयम् ।
बालामप्राप्तवयसमजातव्यञ्जनाकृतिम् ॥

meaning.en: 'How then could I give up my own daughter, a girl not yet grown, without the marks of womanhood?

verses.text:
भर्तुरर्थाय निक्षिप्तां न्यासं धात्रा महात्मना ।
यस्यां दौहित्रजाँल्लोकानाशंसे पितृभिः सह ।
स्वयमुत्पाद्य तां बालां कथमुत्स्रष्टुमुत्सहे ॥

meaning.en: 'She was laid down by the great Creator as a trust for her husband. I hope for worlds with my ancestors through the sons she will bear. How can I, having begotten her, bring myself to cast her away?

verses.text:
मन्यन्ते केचिदधिकं स्नेहं पुत्रे पितुर्नराः ।
कन्यायां नैव तु पुनर्मम तुल्यावुभौ मतौ ॥

meaning.en: 'Some men think a father's love is greater for a son; but not for a daughter. For me the two are equal.

verses.text:
यस्मिँल्लोकाः प्रसूतिश्च स्थिता नित्यमथो सुखम् ।
अपापां तामहं बालां कथमुत्स्रष्टुमुत्सहे ॥

meaning.en: 'On whom the worlds, the line, and always happiness rest: how can I give up that sinless child?

verses.text:
आत्मानमपि चोत्सृज्य तप्स्ये प्रेतवशं गतः ।
त्यक्ता ह्येते मया व्यक्तं नेह शक्ष्यन्ति जीवितुम् ॥

meaning.en: 'And if I gave up myself too, I would burn in Yama's power; for if I leave these they surely cannot live here.

verses.text:
एषां चान्यतमत्यागो नृशंसो गर्हितो बुधैः ।
आत्मत्यागे कृते चेमे मरिष्यन्ति मया विना ॥

meaning.en: 'Giving up any one of them is cruel and blamed by the wise; and if I give up myself, they will die without me.

verses.text:
स कृच्छ्रामहमापन्नो न शक्तस्तर्तुमापदम् ।
अहो धिक्कां गतिं त्वद्य गमिष्यामि सबान्धवः ।
सर्वैः सह मृतं श्रेयो न तु मे जीवितं क्षमम् ॥

meaning.en: 'So I have fallen into trouble and cannot cross it. Alas, what end shall I come to today with my kin? It is better to die with all of them; my own life is not worth keeping.'
